result.summary: Found 3 issues related to content truncation and layout in the food delivery app interface. The overall design is clean and functional, but there are minor visual issues with text truncation and inconsistent element visibility.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, making it unclear what the full name is.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly aligned or add visual indication (like a peek/fade) that shows more content is available by scrolling, or truncate with an ellipsis within the card boundaries.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white/outlined heart on a light circle, while the pizza card below has a white heart on a dark circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off, showing only the image and '-100%' badge without the restaurant details, which may confuse users about whether content is loading or missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card either shows fully or clearly indicates it's below the fold; verify the layout renders complete card information when scrolled into view.
